verificationEvidence.note: syncGlobalAgents writes a thin-shim regular file per template: verbatim frontmatter (tools sandbox preserved, multi-line + inline forms), CLI-fetch body referencing lattice agent_prompt --role=<name>, role body absent. PASS.
Idempotent re-run reports shim ok (skipped=N); old full copy, old symlink, broken link, drifted shim all unlink+rewrite (replaced=N) back to deterministic shim. PASS.

In-process handler output is byte-equal to readPromptTemplate(entry) for all 16 roles (same registry Codex resolves); CLI process adds only the generic print-time trailing newline. Unknown role lists available roles; blank role rejected by runtime re-validate beyond Zod min(1); non-writable global dir throws Cannot create global agents dir ... will not fall back. PASS.
